✈️ FINAL DONATION UPDATE – OHM’S BIRTHDAY CHARITY PROJECT ✈️

Hello, OhmPooners family! This is the final update for OHM THITIWAT’S BIRTHDAY CHARITY PROJECT, and we are now officially closing this donation drive. 🥰🙇🏻‍♀️🙏🏻

Thanks to everyone’s generosity, we set a goal of ₱10,000 and received a total of ₱10,100, exceeding our target. Your support made it possible for us to provide meals to people in need and make Ohm’s birthday celebration more meaningful through this heartfelt initiative. 🍛🤍

We truly appreciate every single donation — big or small. Your kindness and support show how much Ohm is loved and supported by his fans. ✨

💌 A sincere thank you to all our donors. All donors will be officially acknowledged in the upcoming birthday project completion announcement to recognize everyone who supported this initiative.

📌 Donation Breakdown:
The complete breakdown and project documentation will be shared soon for transparency.

Thank you for being part of this meaningful birthday project and for helping us turn love into kindness and compassion. 🫶🏻✨

Apologies for the late announcement, and thank you for your patience 🙏🏻🙇🏻‍♀️

In celebration of the 29th birthday of Ohm Thitiwat, OhmPoon PH proudly launches a Birthday Charity Project dedicated to providing meals for homeless and vulnerable individuals in Thailand.

This initiative aims to turn birthday love into meaningful action. Each sponsored meal set includes a rice meal, drinking water, and bread, and will be prepared and distributed by a trusted local outreach provider in Thailand. Through this project, we hope to spread kindness and warmth in honor of Ohm’s special day.

🗓 Donation Period:
February 21, 2026 – March 31, 2026

🇵🇭 PH Fans – GOTyme Bank (see poster)
🌏 International Fans – PayPal & Wise (see poster)
